0022600178.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-6, 12th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 4.5 games back) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-1, 2nd in the West, 0.5 games back in the Southwest) on a five-game losing streak, having won two of four road games but none of four at home. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Kelly Oubre Jr. (knee bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
